resources.title: Host Handbook
resources.guide1Body: Shoot during golden hour (6:30–8:00 AM or 4:30–6:00 PM) to capture Chiang Dao's mountain mist. Include at least 1 wide exterior shot, 2 bright bedroom angles, and 1 dining/balcony view.
resources.guide2Body: PakJai connects travelers directly to you with 0% commission. Make sure your LINE ID and phone number are up to date under 'Host & Rules' when editing your listing.
resources.guide3Body: Verified hosts receive a badge and priority placement in the Heritage Collection. Keep pricing transparent and respond promptly to traveler inquiries.
